descriptions.d24c_powerbar_init_800f03a0: Load the HUD.Powerbar mesh into +28 retaining it; read active worm, fill, maximum, next, position, size and chat settings into retained references +92..+116, releasing previous values; read the bar size setting; copy the position value to +32 and pass it to the mesh (virtual +76); set the mesh mode 1 and size 1; clear its first index byte and set its first flag to 1; set its colour from the shared colour 0x804af024 with alpha from the next setting; set its two 2D pairs from pool floats 0x8038c214 and 0x8038c218; subscribe five handlers at +44..+60; open the bazooka power sound into +88.
